name: @papercusp/locks
description: SU-agent file-lock coordinator: PG-backed cross-process file claims over a dedicated papercusp_su side-database with its own pools, pg_advisory_xact_lock serialization, FIFO grant cascade, LISTEN/NOTIFY wait subsystem, and background expiry janitor. Implements @papercusp/file-claim's FileClaimCoordinator (SuLocksCoordinator). Host-agnostic — the embedded-pg admin URL is injected via configureLocks(); coordinationDomain is an opaque caller string. Zero @papercusp/@restart runtime deps besides the @papercusp/file-claim interface.
